user.title: Connect to the engine
user.description: Enter the address and the API key of the Pet Recognition Engine. With the engine app on Home Assistant OS, the engine is usually discovered instead.

data_description.url: The engine's address, such as http://docker-host:8765.
data_description.api_key: The key set in the engine's API key option, or its API_KEY variable.

hassio_confirm.title: Engine found
hassio_confirm.description: Connect to the Pet Recognition Engine of the {app} app?

reconfigure.title: Change the engine
reconfigure.description: Enter the engine's new address. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

data_description.url: The engine's address, such as http://docker-host:8765.
data_description.api_key: A new key, only if the engine's key changed.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The engine at {url} refused its API key. Enter the engine's current key.

data_description.api_key: The key set in the engine's API key option, or its API_KEY variable.

user.title: Add a pet
user.description: Name the pet and choose its species. Photos come next.

data_description.name: How the pet is shown, such as in notifications.
data_description.species: Only animals of this species are compared with the pet.

photos.title: Photos of {pet}
photos.description: Photos so far: {count}. Add photos where the pet is the only animal, from different angles and lights. More can be added later.

photo.title: Upload a photo of {pet}
photo.description: A JPEG, PNG or WebP photo where {pet} is the only animal, or a zip archive of such photos. Submit without a photo to go back.

folder.title: Add the photos of a folder
folder.description: Upload several photos at once in **Media**, under **My media**, in a folder of their own, then choose it here. Each JPEG, PNG or WebP photo of the folder where {pet} is the only animal is added, without its subfolders. The files stay in the media. Submit without a folder to go back.

learned.title: Photos of {pet}

capture.title: Take a photo of {pet}
capture.description: Take a photo now from a camera or image entity, while {pet} is the only animal in view. Submit without an entity to go back.

remove.title: Remove examples of {pet}
remove.description:
Choose the examples to remove, such as those that show another animal.

user.title: Add a source
user.description: A source is a place where pets are seen, such as a feeder, and the image or camera entities that show it.

data_description.name: How the source is shown, such as in notifications.
data_description.kind: What the source is, for its defaults.
data_description.entities: Each new picture of an image entity is analyzed. A camera takes pictures when its trigger fires.

details.title: Details of {source}
details.description: Choose the pets of {source}. Pictures already shown are not analyzed, only new ones.

data_description.pets: The pets that may appear at this source. None chosen means every pet.
data_description.ask_when_unsure: Once every pet has examples, ask the phones of the options who it was when a visit of this source stays unknown.
data_description.meal_pictures: The entities of the source whose new pictures each mean a meal, such as a feeder's picture of its last meal. With them, pets count per meal instead of per visit.

camera.name: Cameras
camera.description: Cameras take pictures only when their trigger fires.

data_description.trigger: A motion sensor or an event entity. Each time it turns on, or a new event comes, the cameras take pictures.
data_description.frames: How many pictures each camera takes when the trigger fires.
data_description.interval: The time between two pictures of the same camera.

data_description.gap: Pictures taken closer than this belong to the same visit.
data_description.late: How long pictures may arrive after they were taken. Cloud devices may need more.
data_description.every_picture_shows_a_pet: The source takes pictures only when a pet is there, so a visit where no animal is found counts as unknown.

engine_unreachable.title: The Pet Recognition Engine does not answer
engine_unreachable.description: The engine at {url} has not answered as a Pet Recognition Engine for a quarter of an hour, so no picture can be recognized. Check that the engine app or container runs, and that this is its address. If the engine moved, use **Reconfigure** on the integration.

engine_incompatible.title: Update the Pet Recognition integration
engine_incompatible.description: The engine at {url} no longer serves version {api} of the API, which this integration speaks. Update the integration to the release of the engine.

engine_version_newer.title: The Pet Recognition Engine is newer than the integration
engine_version_newer.description: The engine is release {engine} and the integration release {integration}. They still work together, but update the integration so that both are of the same release.

engine_version_older.title: The Pet Recognition Engine is older than the integration
engine_version_older.description: The engine is release {engine} and the integration release {integration}. They still work together, but update the engine app or container so that both are of the same release.

pet_without_examples.title: {pet} has no examples
pet_without_examples.description: {pet} cannot be recognized without photos. Open the integration, select the gear button of {pet} (**Change pet**), and add photos where it is the only animal.

entities.title: Entities of {source}
entities.description: Home Assistant no longer knows {entities}. Choose the image or camera entities {source} uses now, and a trigger if one of them is a camera.

data_description.trigger: Needed when a camera is chosen.

error.entity_in_use: One of these entities is already used by another source.
error.no_entity: Choose at least one image or camera entity.
error.trigger_needed: Choose a trigger for the cameras.

notify_device_missing.title: A phone to ask is gone
notify_device_missing.description: A phone chosen in the options of Pet Recognition is no longer a device of the Home Assistant companion app, so it gets no questions. Open the integration, select **Configure**, and choose the phones again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Changes apply once the integration loads again. Questions on the phones go through the Home Assistant companion app, with the names of the pets and the source, the time, and a link to the picture: the picture itself stays in Home Assistant.

data_description.phones: Each phone gets a notification when a visit stays unknown, with the picture and a button per pet. None chosen means no questions.
data_description.ask_while_learning: While a pet has no examples yet, ask about one visit at a time, so that the answers teach the first examples.

data_description.threshold: How much an animal must resemble the examples of a pet, from 0 to 1, for the pet to be decided. Higher means fewer mistakes and more unknown visits.
data_description.margin: How far ahead of the next pet the score must be.
data_description.min_area: Animals smaller than this share of a picture are left out, such as far away in a garden.
data_description.detection_limit: The most animals looked for in one picture.
data_description.retention: How long pictures, their crops and the journal are kept. Long-term statistics are kept by Home Assistant.

assign_visit.name: Assign visit
assign_visit.description: Says which pets were at a visit, which corrects all its pictures and teaches the animal of a single pet.

visit_id.name: Visit
visit_id.description: The ID of the visit, as its events and the visits to review give it.

source.name: Source
source.description: An entity of a source, for its latest visit, or to look for the visit there only.

pets.name: Pets
pets.description: The pets that were there. None, without the other animal, says it is unknown.

other_animal.name: Other animal
other_animal.description: An animal that is none of the pets was there too.
